LanguageData.Make_Rawhide.label: make rawhide
LanguageData.Make_Rawhide.description: Combine various types of hides and pelts to create rawhide. Typical thought of as an emergency resource when leather tanning cannot be done, given rawhide's weak durability and lifespan.
